pattern: prevent all damage that {g:Filter} would deal to players {d:Dur}
subject: none

examples.text: Prevent all damage that red creatures would deal to players this turn.
Draw a card. Prevent all damage that creatures with flying would deal to players this turn.

counterExamples: Prevent all damage that red creatures would deal to players.
Prevent all combat damage that red creatures would deal to players this turn.
Prevent all damage that red creatures would deal to you this turn.

pattern: as long as you control exactly one creature , that creature get[s] {pt:PT} and has {a:Abilities}

examples.text: As long as you control exactly one creature, that creature gets +2/+2 and has vigilance.
As long as you control exactly one creature, that creature gets +2/+2 and has trample and haste.

counterExamples: As long as you control exactly two creatures, that creature gets +3/+1 and has lifelink.
As long as you control exactly one creature, that creature gets +3/+1 and loses lifelink.
As long as you control exactly one creature, that creature gets +3/+1 and has lifelink until end of turn.

pattern: prevent all damage that would be dealt to {o:Obj} {d:Dur} . for each 1 damage prevented this way , put a {k:CounterKind} counter on that creature
subject: none

examples.text: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target artifact creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a time counter on that creature.

counterExamples: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 2 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn. For each 1 damage prevented this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.

subject: object

examples.text: Creatures you control get +0/+1 until end of turn for each Wizard you control.
Goblins you control get +1/+0 until end of turn for each artifact you control.

counterExamples: Creatures you control get +0/+1 for each Wizard you control.

pattern: if a source would deal damage to {f:Filter} , it deals that much damage minus {n:Qty} to that creature instead

examples.text: If a source would deal damage to an artifact creature you control, it deals that much damage minus 1 to that creature instead.
If a source would deal damage to a Goblin you control, it deals that much damage minus 2 to that creature instead.

counterExamples: If a source would deal damage to a creature you control, it deals that much damage plus 1 to that creature instead.
If a source would deal damage to a creature you control, it deals that much damage minus 1 to that creature.
If a source would deal damage to a creature you control, it deals that much damage minus 1 to you instead.
